findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council approved the routine consent agenda, authorized the renewal of annual municipal property, casualty, and workers' compensation insurance coverage, and approved the purchase of a replacement police squad car. Council members also shared brief announcements regarding an upcoming public library fundraiser and the community Lightworks walkthrough event before adjourning.
